title: Metadata extraction Zeiss CZI before conversion to JPEG/TIFF
author: Scott John
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6xphfmn

steps.title: Install Required Software
steps.instruction: Set up the necessary environment on a Mac to process CZI files.

substeps.instruction: Install legacy Java 6 runtime for macOS 10.13 from https://support.apple.com/kb/DL1572?locale=en_US
Install Fiji and allow it to update automatically

steps.title: Import CZI File
steps.instruction: Open the CZI file in Fiji and configure the Bio-Formats import settings.

substeps.instruction: In the 'Bio-Formats Import Options' window, under metadata viewing, check: 'Display metadata', 'Display OME-XML metadata', and 'Display ROIs'

steps.title: Export Metadata
steps.instruction: Save the extracted metadata as a CSV file before converting the image.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the 'File' menu and select 'Save As' to export the metadata as a csv formatted file

steps.title: Convert Image File
steps.instruction: Save the image files in the desired format, such as TIFF or JPEG.
